svg.title: A first-incident review checklist scoring whether the rollout caught it cleanly
svg.desc: A black canvas shows a vertical checklist of three questions in cream boxes: did the alert fire with lead time, did it carry sufficient evidence, did the named owner see it, each followed by a yes marked in acid-yellow, illustrating a structured post-incident review of the observability rollout itself.

g.text: Did the alert fire with enough lead time to matter?
Did it carry evidence sufficient to act without digging?
Did the named owner actually see and act on it?

svg.text: uncoil.dev · the first real incident is the most honest test the rollout will get
